measurement_notes: All initial and focused follow-up matched samples are retained. Only measurements of the final compiler are pooled for acceptance; intermediate pilots remain diagnostic.

Instruction counts are diagnostic, not a replacement for elapsed CPU-time acceptance. Both unaligned and final instruction counts are retained separately; only the final compiler participates in stage acceptance.
The host is contended. Paired approximate bootstrap intervals do not establish universal performance. Absolute rates across changing loads are not a compiler speedup.
Exact artifact equivalence masks only equal-width compiler bundle paths. Timings shared within a run are identified explicitly, with preflight and full-size warmup checks of every binary.
The 250k fresh root lines/s and universal C/Rust runtime targets remain unmet. The new value-parameter workload exposes additional default/release gaps to C.
